options.name: inherits_from
options.description: Existing base role names to inherit permissions from. The module fetches these roles on every run and reconciles the target role against the composed permission set. Each listed role must exist.

options.name: ldap_group_dn
options.description: LDAP group distinguished name to associate with the role. When omitted, the module leaves the current LDAP group binding unchanged. Set to an empty string to clear an existing LDAP group binding.

options.name: ms_entra_id_group_ids
options.description: Microsoft Entra ID group identifiers associated with the role. When omitted, the module leaves the current Entra ID group bindings unchanged. Set to an empty list to clear existing Entra ID group bindings.

options.name: permission_mode
options.description: How I(permissions) is interpreted when I(inherits_from) is set. C(exact) applies exactly the inherited permissions and does not accept additional explicit permissions. C(additive) adds I(permissions) to the inherited permissions. C(subtractive) removes I(permissions) from the inherited permissions. Without I(inherits_from), only C(exact) is supported and existing behavior is preserved.

options.name: permissions
options.description: A list of permissions. When omitted, the module leaves the current role permissions unchanged. Set to an empty list to remove all permissions from the role. When I(inherits_from) is set and I(permission_mode=additive), these permissions are added to the inherited permissions. When I(inherits_from) is set and I(permission_mode=subtractive), these permissions are removed from the inherited permissions.

options.name: target_hostname
options.description: Used to connect to the Connectware API

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Flag to enable Connectware certificate checking
